data.name: Durand
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German words 'thuri' meaning fortress and 'hands' meaning ruler or protector. Durand was a common name among the Germanic peoples, particularly among the knights and nobles. The name is believed to signify strength, protection, and leadership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Durand has a rich historical background, particularly in Europe, where it was commonly used among the nobility and knights. It evokes images of strength, honor, and leadership, reminding us of the valiant warriors of the Middle Ages who bore this name. The name continues to be popular today, carrying the weight of history and legacy.

It can be seen as a reminder of God's protection and strength, evoking a sense of security and reassurance. Furthermore, the name can be a source of inspiration for those who bear it, encouraging them to be strong and protect others, just as the name suggests.
